messages:
Lena: Heads up — we need to lock the SI handshake + marketplace announcement flow for CloudForge SI next week. Can we sync on lead routing, account mapping, and who owns joint customer comms? @Raj @Tom
Raj: I can lead intake for EMEA accounts. What's the expected volume roughly?
Tom: NA looks like ~12 new SI-introduced prospects, 3 confirmed demos. I’ll aggregate in the SI pipeline sheet tonight.
Maya: Link the sheet? I’ll take ownership of attribution rules once it’s populated. Also we should gate the press timing to the marketplace listing.
Lena: Sheet (working): https://airtable.com/shrFakeLink123 — use the "SI Intake" view. Quick proposed rules: 
- SI brings lead => SI owns first-touch and discovery
- Redwood runs product demo + pricing conversations after discovery handoff
- Handoff via SFDC task with label `/si-handoff` and attach sheet row ID
- Revenue credit: default 70/30 (SI/Redwood), exceptions for named accounts (> $250k ARR)
Thoughts?
Sofia: Looks good. For named accounts we should carve back to the local AE and log as "strategic carve" in the sheet. Also we need partner logo + one-sentence quote for marketplace page — marketing needs by Wed noon.
Raj: Agree on carve-outs. Also propose a fast-path for urgent enterprise leads: SI flags as "priority" and we have 24h SLA for Redwood to respond.
Tom: Adding a "priority" column in the sheet now. I’ll also create a filtered view for NA/EMEA.
marketplace-bot: CloudForge listing status: approved in staging; deployment to production scheduled 2027-09-13 18:00 UTC.
Lena: Nice. So timeline proposal: listing deploy Thu -> internal verification Fri morning -> joint public blog + partner PR Fri afternoon. If staging shows issues, delay public PR until verified.
Maya: I’ll create the SFDC task template named "SI Handoff" and wire attribution to the partner field + 70/30 split default. Will post sample task JSON in the sheet.
Tom: I’ll own the canonical sheet (read/write permissions to partnerships + sales + revops). Dropping current NA accounts now.
Raj: I’ll set a standing 15m sync (Tue 9am PT) for the next 3 weeks to triage handoffs and early pipeline.
Sofia: Marketing will own the announcement copy and landing page. Need partner logo (transparent PNG), one liner quote, and the list of supported cloud images by Wed noon.
Lena: Capturing decisions/actions: 1) Airtable sheet is canonical intake. 2) SI first-touch, Redwood demo/quote. 3) Named-account carve-outs to AE. 4) Marketplace listing = signal to trigger public comms. 5) Create SFDC task template + `/si-handoff` tag. 6) Weekly 15m sync for 3 weeks.
Maya: I’ll post the SFDC task template link and attribution rule doc in the sheet later today.
Tom: Done — NA list uploaded, watch the "priority" flag.
Raj: Thanks — will kick off EMEA intake and ping marketing for PR alignment.
Lena: Thanks everyone :rocket: If anything blocks, @me or drop it in the sheet under "blocks" column.
Raj: Thanks — good plan.
